title: Differential Diagnosis for the Causes of Subclavian Steal for Patients With Vascular Access in the Forearm
brief_summary: Subclavian steal phenomenon is normally observed in patients with stenosis of subclavian artery proximal to orifice of vertebral artery(V0). However, uremic patients undergoing hemodialysis using vascular access in the arm or forearm may also develop dialysis associated steal syndrome(DASS).For patients with symptomatic subclavian steal phenomenon, the treatment for these two groups is different. The investigators want to see if the investigators can use noninvasive duplex examination instead of invasive conventional angiography to do the differential diagnosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients who revealed subclavian steal in the duplex study

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who has vascular access in the arm instead of the forearm
